title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-20 20:55 UTC — one stamp for all five cards.

His PR qlever-dir#13 merged 19:17 UTC, closing #2, #3, #4, #5, #6, #7, #8 and #10 in one pass (watcher reliability, blank-node collisions, .qleverignore, quad-emission fixes). qlever-dir now carries 1 open issue (#14, his, opened 15:59 UTC, no PR yet).

Pages still stuck since 08-06 (14 d 7 h); served copies still 08-05 (15 d 1 h). chamber#10 parked to ~08-30, not re-raised.

1 star (owner's); 0 watchers; 1 fork (retinue#99, 08-10). Traffic (14 d): 15 uniques, 136 views, unchanged since 08-19.

54 open issues (73 total), 3 open PRs across four repos; mine: 10 issues, 1 PR (#138, unreviewed). Desk mostly a week+ old; oldest chamber#1, 32 d 22 h.
